method: Fresh browser context per run; default terrain seed 42026 and naturally randomized props/units/enemies; 5x UI speed; zoom out via mouse wheel to the normal maximum; actual WebGL; no API writes, forced events, era/day jumps, clock/RNG overrides or render stubs.

policy.observe: No powers/recruitment; close naturally occurring events.
policy.economy: Recruit two workers before night; rain near workers at most once per 45 game seconds while faith >= 30 and food < 65 or mean hunger > 45; choose affordable economic options in natural events.
policy.defense: Train two soldiers; attempt one extra tower on visibly accessible free ground before night; use lightning on a visible enemy cluster at most once per 12 game seconds while faith >= 25; choose affordable defensive options in natural events.
policy.common: Stop at 240 game seconds; record automatic era transition if reached; do not force progression. Input may pause via the visible pause button for aiming/screenshots. Policies are simple scripted play styles, not expert human players.

stopReason: Stopped after the complete observe run to correct confirmed shelter access and fishing-target interactions before the final NPC verification phase. Any additional incomplete directory is diagnostic only.
